_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Student Guide
summary: The Student Guide provides the background, scheduling, and study materials used to orient the student to the training system and aid in skill and knowledge acquisition.
use_relationship:
The Student Guide is a detailed written guide that provides the background, scheduling, and study materials to be used by the student. The guide is used to orient the student to the training system and to aid the student in the acquisition of skills and knowledge required in a course of instruction.
a. This Data Item Description (DID) is applicable to all contracts requiring courseware development. This DID is related to DI-MISC-81457, Lesson Strategy Report; DI-MISC-81458, Instructor Planning Document; and DI-MISC-81459, Syllabus. (Copies of these DIDs are available online at https://quicksearch.dla.mil.)
b. This DID contains the format, content, and intended use information for the data deliverable resulting from the work task described in the solicitation.
c. This DID supersedes DI-MISC-81456A.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference documents.
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as specified in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The Student Guide shall include the following sections:

children.title: Assignment sheet.
children.content: The assignment sheet shall identify the required reading material and pose questions on the assignments for each individual topic. The assignment sheet shall consist of:

children.title: Study questions written on the same skill level as the related learning objective.
Problem sheet.
children.content: The problem sheet shall provide the student with practical problems requiring analysis and decision-making similar to those problems, which can occur in the operational environment. Problem sheets shall consist of:

children.title: Introduction consisting of narrative statements concerning the purpose and intent of the problem sheet.
List of all reference documentation required to perform the task or function.
Problem statements with all the data necessary to solve the problem(s).
Outline sheet.
children.content: The outline sheet shall provide the student with an outline of the topic's major teaching points. Outline sheets shall allow students to follow the progress of a topic, to take notes as desired, and to retain topic information for future reference. Outline sheets shall consist of:

children.title: An introduction explaining the purpose and intent of the outline sheet.
An outline of the topic content.
Student orientation.
children.content: The student orientation shall orient the student to all aspects of the training system (e.g., syllabus, command organization, base and surrounding area data) and shall consist of the following information:

children.title: Overview of the purpose of the course.
Description of the command organization (personnel, policies, roles, and relationships).
Training program components (instructional features, syllabus sequence, media formats, and security and safety features).
Description of the training system operation, scheduling, student roles and responsibilities, and student-learning center operating procedures.
Instructor roles in the learning center (evaluation test procedures, student remediation process, recording of test scores, and checkout procedures).
Operation equipment procedures (audiovisual and training aids).
